title: Joe Burrow backtracks from "throw it more": I might have been a little emotional after the game

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Joe Burrow backtracks from "throw it more": I might have been a little emotional after the game
sources.description: After the Bengals had just 13 designed runs for 18 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Jaguars, Joe Burrow’s response was, “Let’s throw it more.”
